architecture_debts: composite owned values and aggregate control-flow ownership
specialized collection identity versus parametric abstraction
semantic.py module scale and ownership/layout coupling
bounded developer tooling and self-hosting scope

milestones.title: Composite Owned Values
milestones.why_now: Dynamic bytes/text/collections cannot be fields of records, arrays, or enums; this is the largest application-model gap.
milestones.scope: owned bytes, text, vectors, maps, and sets in explicitly declared aggregates
milestones.public_surface: bounded owned bytes, text, vectors, maps, and sets as explicitly declared aggregate fields
milestones.internal_architecture: whole-aggregate ownership, inline target-aligned layout, field projections, allocation identity, and deterministic destruction metadata
environment_requirements: Linux native for descriptor ABI evidence
milestones.risks: aggregate layout, partial construction, and cleanup ABI
milestones.exit_criteria: normative aggregate ownership contract is closed; implementation and hosted/reference gates remain pending

milestones.title: Aggregate Move Borrow Drop Flow
milestones.why_now: M1.51 layout is insufficient without control-flow-complete ownership transfer.
milestones.scope: path-sensitive ownership at joins, returns, early exits, and loops
milestones.public_surface: no new broad syntax beyond aggregate-safe existing operations
milestones.internal_architecture: path-sensitive ownership state at joins, returns, loops, and exceptional traps
milestones.exit_criteria: verifier proves exactly-once cleanup on all valid paths

milestones.title: Constrained Generic Functions V1
milestones.why_now: Repeated specialized functions become costly after ownership is stable.
milestones.scope: closed compile-time generic functions with deterministic monomorphization
milestones.public_surface: closed generic functions with explicit type parameters and a finite scalar/owned constraint set
milestones.risks: code-size explosion and accidental trait system
milestones.exit_criteria: constrained specializations are concrete before IR/Assembly

milestones.title: Parametric Records and Enums
milestones.why_now: Generic functions alone cannot model reusable domain aggregates.
milestones.scope: closed acyclic parametric aggregates with concrete specialized layouts
milestones.public_surface: closed parametric records/enums with explicit type arguments
milestones.internal_architecture: nominal identity includes canonical arguments; acyclic layout remains mandatory
environment_requirements: Linux native for aggregate ABI evidence
milestones.exit_criteria: parametric aggregates remain compatible with ownership and fixed-layout contracts

milestones.title: Generic Ordered Vector V1
milestones.why_now: Vectors are the first high-value collection migration target.
milestones.scope: first generic ordered collection with explicit capacity and compatibility migration
milestones.public_surface: generic ordered vector with explicit element constraints and capacity policy
milestones.internal_architecture: replace specialized duplication through a compatibility-preserving specialization layer
environment_requirements: Linux native for concrete vector ABI
milestones.exit_criteria: generic vector works without erasing closed specialized families

milestones.title: Local Package Dependencies V1
milestones.why_now: Modules exist, but larger applications need reproducible dependency identity.
milestones.scope: local path and pinned Git revision dependencies with offline lock resolution
milestones.public_surface: local path and pinned Git revision dependencies plus namespace identity
milestones.internal_architecture: locked dependency graph, cycle detection, offline resolution
milestones.risks: nondeterministic remote resolution and namespace collisions
milestones.exit_criteria: locked dependencies build offline with identical identities

milestones.title: Content-Addressed Incremental Builds
milestones.why_now: M1.45 has artifact identity but not dependency-aware reuse.
milestones.scope: dependency-aware exact artifact reuse keyed by canonical content
milestones.public_surface: deterministic build plan and warm/cold diagnostics
milestones.internal_architecture: content-addressed artifact store keyed by canonical inputs
milestones.exit_criteria: warm builds reuse only exact compatible artifacts

milestones.title: Language Server Protocol V1
milestones.why_now: Stable package identity and diagnostics make bounded editor tooling useful.
milestones.public_surface: initialize, didOpen, didChange, diagnostics, hover, definition, symbols, deterministic completion
milestones.internal_architecture: request-scoped analysis over existing compiler APIs; no new semantic authority
milestones.risks: second compiler front end and unbounded IDE scope
milestones.exit_criteria: editor facts come from the authoritative compiler

milestones.title: Canonical Source and Developer Experience
milestones.why_now: Human usability remains the largest adoption gap after the semantic foundation.
milestones.public_surface: formatter, project init, build/test/run UX, error summaries, examples/templates, capability discovery
milestones.internal_architecture: thin deterministic CLI surfaces over existing contracts
milestones.risks: duplicate capability claims and documentation drift
milestones.exit_criteria: a human can discover, build, test, and diagnose a small project predictably

milestones.title: Bounded Self-Hosted Manifest/Test Reader
milestones.why_now: The project can validate a small self-hosted component without attempting a compiler rewrite.
milestones.scope: one bounded manifest or test-report reader with Python oracle and fallback
milestones.public_surface: one manifest or test-report reader with a documented fallback
milestones.internal_architecture: bounded parser utility in S3 with Python oracle
milestones.exit_criteria: one useful bounded component has exact deterministic parity and safe fallback

not_required_when: narrow runtime fix with T1/T2/T3 evidence
test_policy.after_t4_failure: rerun exact failed nodes and affected closures, then resume valid shards

open_decisions: choose package namespace identity before M1.56
